lines.text: Many learners say: She wears a short rock.
Better: She wears a short skirt.
Rock is a stone or music.
Skirt! She wears a long skirt.

data.why: Rock is a stone or music.

native.tip: Auf Englisch ist „rock“ Stein oder Musik. Das Kleidungsstück heißt „skirt“.

en.hook: How do you say “Rock” to wear?
en.tip: In English “rock” is a stone or music. The piece of clothing is a “skirt”.
en.caption: How do you say “Rock” to wear? Wrong: “She wears a short rock.” Right: “She wears a short skirt.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
